content_text: Are the movies Blade runner 2049, No country for old men, and The assassination of Jesse James West by the coward Robert Ford influenced by Neo western and Noir films? I ask this because for the IB diploma I’m doing a in depth study into these three films and wondered if Mr.Deakins would considered these valid influences.
